sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Silver-Plated Adjustable AD Stone Criss-Cross Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add a touch of elegance to your collection with this silver-plated adjustable ring, beautifully designed with a sparkling American Diamond (AD) stone at the center and a stylish criss-cross band. Perfect for daily wear, party looks, or gifting, this ring blends minimalism with sophistication.
- Material: Brass base
- Plating: Premium Silver-plated finish
- Stone Type: Sparkling American Diamond (AD)
- Design: Criss-cross band with central solitaire-style stone
- Size & Fit: Adjustable – fits comfortably on most finger sizes
- Style & Use: Ideal for daily wear, casual outings, parties, and gifting
